title: Retrospective sample v1
description: docs/programs/<program>/retro-sample-<n>.json (D-327): a retrospective's sample of merged PRs, 10 per retrospective, each with the answer to "was there a clearly cheaper path that solved it?" (yes or no and one line). The share of yes is the measure scripts/model reads, target under 10 %; never a field a PR fills. Independent audits record `reviewer` distinct from `author_session` (M5).

reviewer.description: Independent reviewer (person or distinct reviewer session) who audited this retrospective sample; must differ from author_session.

author_session.description: Session or author that produced the sampled PRs; when present alongside reviewer, reviewer must not equal author_session.
